description: Fixtures for falsePromises / noFalsePromise (evals/lib/assertions.mjs). `opusReply` is Opus 5.5's reply in job-no-promise-on-failure from the first live Claude Code baseline, which the old negative-lookahead regex wrongly failed. `pass` must yield no false claims; `fail` must yield at least one.
